title: chore(storybook): update to Storybook 5
body:
This upgrades to Storybook 5 ([see migration notes](https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/blob/next/MIGRATION.md#from-version-41x-to-50x)).

Since the [URL structure changed](https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/blob/next/MIGRATION.md#new-url-structure), we need to update the documentation story links when merging this PR.

[See stories →](https://deploy-preview-3585--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories)
